title: MAP draft + vendor enrollment steps for Crestline Health
text:
MAP draft + vendor enrollment steps for Crestline Health

['From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <l.park@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps (vendor onboarding)

Hi Lydia —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery:

- Goal: Get Redwood integrated for document summarization + triage for incoming provider forms by Q3.
- Primary blockers: procurement/vendor enrollment (Coupa), legal review of DPA, and bank account verification for ACH.
- Decision criteria: latency under 150ms P95, SOC2 evidence, predictable per-request cost.

Agreed next steps / MAP milestones (draft):
1) Procurement kickoff (you) — Crestline sends vendor contact & which portal (Coupa confirmed in call). Target: 2026-04-23
2) Vendor forms completed — W-9 + vendor enrollment in Coupa (Crestline) — Target: 2026-04-29
3) Legal review (Redwood + Crestline) — sign DPA redlines by 2026-05-06
4) Payment setup — bank details & test ACH by 2026-05-10
5) Integration runbook + smoke test — 2026-05-14

Ben/Marissa — I’ll need an enrollment packet (Ariba/Coupa instructions) and a short one-pager on SOC2 artifacts we can share with procurement.

Lydia — can you confirm the procurement contact and whether we should upload to Coupa directly or if Crestline prefers us to complete an enrollment form and you’ll enter it? Also attaching the W-9 request so you can confirm the information format you need.

Attachments: Crestline_W-9.pdf (stub)

Thanks — I’ll draft a MAP doc with explicit owners and send back for your sign-off.

—
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187
', 'From: Lydia Park <l.park@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Crestline Procurement <procurement@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps (vendor onboarding)

Thanks Jonas — great summary. Quick answers below: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@crestlinehealth.com (Evelyn Song, will loop if needed)
- Portal: We use Coupa for vendor onboarding. We can either provide a vendor invite or accept a completed enrollment form from you. Prefer we do the invite if possible.
- Attached: Signed W-9 (Crestline_W-9.pdf) and a short note with our AP details for ACH (bank name + routing masked).

I’ve copied procurement. Evelyn — feel free to call out if you need additional compliance artifacts (SOC2 report, IP clauses, etc.).

On the MAP timeline — the dates look fine but procurement will need one round of review, so expect the DPA step to take ~5 business days.

Lydia

> [original message clipped]

Looping internal owners and proposed internal checklist. Forwarded Lydia’s confirmation below.

Internal action items (owner / ETA):
- Prepare Coupa enrollment packet + vendor invite instructions (Ben) — 2026-04-22 EOD
- SOC2 summary + evidence list (security pack) (Marissa) — 2026-04-22 noon
- Draft MAP with explicit owners & dates (Jonas) — 2026-04-22 morning
- Legal pre-review of DPA redlines (Internal Legal; request kickoff) (Marissa) — 2026-04-23
- Finance: ACH test steps and payment terms (Ben) — 2026-04-27

Notes:
- Ben, make sure Ariba packet included in case procurement asks (Crestline sometimes handles both Coupa and Ariba).
- I’ll prepare a short email template for procurement that lists the SOC2 artifacts and certs; we should include a redacted SOC2 summary to speed review.

Attachments in this thread: Crestline_W-9.pdf (from Lydia)

—
Marissa Cole

Subject: MAP draft + enrollment packet (next steps & signature)

Hi Lydia / Evelyn —

Attaching a draft MAP (RW3319_MAP_Draft.docx) and our Coupa/Ariba enrollment packet (Ariba_Enrollment_Packet.pdf). Please review and confirm owners/dates below; I’ve highlighted the procurement milestone so your team can accept the invite or let us upload the enrollment form.

Summary of current milestone owners (per draft):
- Procurement kickoff & Coupa invite: Crestline procurement (Evelyn) — target 2026-04-23
- Vendor forms (W-9 + enrollment): Crestline (submit) OR Redwood (complete form + submit if you prefer) — target 2026-04-29
- DPA review: Crestline Legal + Redwood Legal — target 2026-05-06
- Payment verification: Crestline AP + Redwood Finance — target 2026-05-10
- Smoke test & go/no-go: Crestline Ops + Redwood Onboarding — target 2026-05-14

If you’re comfortable with the MAP as-is I can generate a DocuSign envelope for the DPA and capture signatures. Link to the HubSpot deal included for your reference.

DocuSign (DPA): https://www.docusign.com/overview/RW3319-MAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4512345/RW-3319-CREST

Would appreciate confirmation on whether you want Redwood to complete the Coupa enrollment form on your behalf (we can do this to accelerate time-to-onboard).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into procurement.

—
